finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

All 3 failures were one bug in `orderTotal`. It taxed the pre-discount `cents`, not the discounted amount. Only rows with both a discount and a tax could expose it.

Fix is one line in [src/pricing.js:40](src/pricing.js:40). It now reuses `applyTax` on the discounted value.

```js
return applyTax(applyDiscount(cents, discountPct), taxRate);
```
